title: Ram chandra series set of 3 & Immortals o Meluha by Amish
seller_comments: Set of 4 books - Ram - Scion of Ikshvaku, Sita: Warrior of Mithila, Raavan: Enemy of Aryavarta and The Immortals of Meluha - Lose yourself in this epic adventure thriller, based on the Ramayana, the story of Lord Ram, Sita and Ravana intertwined. The author has transformed Indian Fiction with his unique combination of mystery, mythology, religious symbolism and philosophy. In this book, you will find all the familiar characters you have heard of, like Lord Ram, Lord Lakshman, Lady Sita, Lord Hanuman, Lord Bharat and many others from Ayodhya. And even some from Lanka like Ravan! The Immortals of Meluha - 1900 BC. In what modern Indians mistakenly call the Indus Valley Civilisation.The inhabitants of that period called it the land of Meluha – a near perfect empire created many centuries earlier by Lord Ram, one of the greatest monarchs that ever lived.This once proud empire and its Suryavanshi rulers face severe perils as its primary river, the revered Saraswati, is slowly drying to extinction. They also face devastating terrorist attacks from the east, the land of the Chandravanshis. To make matters worse, the Chandravanshis appear to have allied with the Nagas, an ostracised and sinister race of deformed humans with astonishing martial skills.
